notes: No real business integration, clinical validation or measured operational savings are claimed.

PharmaColdOps connects cold-chain excursion review with replacement delivery and case evidence.
The data are simulated. This visual draft contains no spoken narration.
M1-M3 handle inputs, exposure calculations and inspectable rules. M5 handles delivery planning and execution.
M4 provides advisory candidates. It cannot authorise medicine disposition.
M6 stores case evidence; M7 exposes the API and bilingual interface. Human outcomes remain separate from original records.
54/57 is agreement with historical adjudicated labels on synthetic scenarios - not overall system accuracy.
All three quarantine-labelled cases are missed. Four-class macro-F1 is 0.7174.
The known policy disagreements remain in the denominator; later manual review does not improve this frozen score.
Shipment risk uses 8,000 rows and 13 features. Formal five-fold F1 is 0.6635 and PR-AUC is 0.7087.
Calibration improves probability loss; it does not establish clinical meaning.
Monthly candidate-cause classification remains weak: random-fold full15 macro-F1 0.1322 and Top-1 0.1713.
These are separate tasks and datasets. Feature attribution is not a confirmed cause.
Temporal v2 improves macro-F1 on the same five held-out simulated cohorts.
Supported-candidate coverage stays low, and the more extreme cohort supports no candidates.
All 3,000 test events still require human review. Results do not establish external physical or clinical validity.
The Singapore static comparison uses three vehicles in both plans: 165.26 km versus 137.85 km.
The 16.59% distance reduction is for one frozen static instance, not measured operational savings.
The formal study has 49 solver runs. Dynamic delivery workflows are verified separately.
Preview, adoption and actual simulated delivery are different states.
Urgent and replacement tasks share operation constraints; completed work is retained.
Day-end terminals are user-selected warehouses only. Real cargo quantities and stock balances are outside the demo scope.
M6 is bounded deterministic routing with five structured queries, not an unrestricted LLM.
Concept help, clarification, refusal and graph-query failures are labelled separately.
Case changes invalidate stale replies. Stored references remain inspectable, but are not medicine-stability certification.
